title: Microgame variant pack (breadth via parameters)
description: Deliver the 'many microgames' goal by reusing the 5 core mechanics with varied shapes, speeds, quotas, and durations as data-only MicrogameDefinition assets, proving the framework makes new microgames cheap.
acceptance_criteria: At least 10 distinct MicrogameDefinition assets exist spanning all 5 mechanics with meaningfully varied parameters.
All variants are registered in the sequencer pool and selectable.
Running the loop plays varied microgames back-to-back without code changes per variant.
Adding a variant requires only a new asset (and shapes/params), demonstrating the data-driven design.
